Vanessa / Marcus,

Looping you in — Acme is likely 24 months, finance is checking thresholds. They flagged two policy points: 1) >15% discount => VP approval, 2) >$200k => CFO. They also want to know whether Redwood or Acme initiates the private offer in AWS (we usually create the offer on our seller account and they accept).

Quick recommended approach from deal desk perspective (draft):
- Offer tenor: 24 months (standard)
- Discount bands: 0–10% (AE approval), 10.1–20% (VP approval), 20%+ (CFO + RevOps signoff)
- Dollar threshold override: any net ARR > $200k requires CFO notification and documented justification in the DocuSign/PO
- Buyer experience: we create the Private Offer in AWS, include custom PO/contract reference, send acceptance link to Acme (procurement accepts under their AWS account)

Questions for you both: are those discount bands operationally okay? Do we need legal signoff for the 20%+ band or is RevOps OK to approve with Legal informed?

I’m happy to propose specific numbers to keep this inside VP approval if we want an expedited path (e.g., reduce list discount to 14% with annualized billing).

Rishi
